subject: Request: Onboarding & Offboarding Controls — background checks, training metrics
messages:
From: Laura Chen <lchen@acme.com>
To: vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai
Cc: security@acme.com
Date: Tue, 12 May 2026 11:14:00 -04:00
Subject: Info request — onboarding/offboarding evidence for SOC2 review

Hi Vivek,

We're running a security review ahead of contract signature and need a concise set of artifacts showing your employee lifecycle controls. Specific asks from our SOC2 checklist:
- Background check coverage (vendor, scope, lookback period)
- Formal new-hire security training (content outline, completion rates)
- Offboarding process (access revocation timing, checklist)

Could you send a short summary plus any supporting artifacts (screenshots or exports are fine) by EOD Thursday 5/14? If there are parts we should redline or where you have compensating controls, flag them.

Thanks,
Laura Chen
Senior Security Engineer
AcmePayments

From: vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai
To: Laura Chen <lchen@acme.com>
Cc: neha.kapoor@redwood.ai, jordan.blake@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 12 May 2026 11:43:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Info request — onboarding/offboarding evidence for SOC2 review

Laura — thanks for the clear list. We can provide the materials you requested. High level answers up front:

- Background checks: vendor is Sterling; checks include identity, SSN trace, criminal and sanction screening; standard lookback is 7 years for US hires, extended per role if needed.
- New-hire security training: mandatory ~90-min course covering data handling, access controls, phishing, and secrets; completion is required within 10 business days of start.
- Offboarding: automated access revocation via IAM playbooks; typical revocation within 4 hours of HR termination notification; documented checklist captured in our HRIS.

I'm attaching a compact bundle (summary CSV + training report + flow diagram). Neha (security/compliance lead) will follow up with the training completion metric and retention policy language.

Attachments: [background_checks_summary.csv], [employee_training_report_Q1_2026.pdf], [offboarding_workflow.drawio]

Best,
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Security & Trust (interim)
Redwood Inference

From: neha.kapoor@redwood.ai
To: Laura Chen <lchen@acme.com>, vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 13 May 2026 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Info request — onboarding/offboarding evidence for SOC2 review

Hi Laura — adding a few specifics per your checklist.

Background checks
- Vendor: Sterling (contracted July 2024). Screens: identity, SSN trace, national criminal databases, global watchlists.
- Coverage: 100% of US-based hires; 92% global coverage (exceptions for contractors in certain countries due to local regulations).
- Records retention: verification results stored for 5 years in encrypted HR storage. See attached vendor_contract_screenshots.png for the Sterling portal and key contract clauses.

Training
- Course: "Security Fundamentals for Redwood" (~90 minutes), covers data classification, MFA, password hygiene, phishing awareness, data exfiltration scenarios and incident reporting.
- Completion metric: 98% completed within 10 business days for full-time hires in Q1 2026; contractors have a tailored 30-day window. Evidence: employee_training_report_Q1_2026.pdf (attached) and completion export in the Drive folder.
- Refresher cadence: annual mandatory refresher + role-specific modules for engineers and SOC personnel.

Offboarding
- Trigger: HR separation event via Workday.
- Automation: IAM scripts revoke cloud console, CI/CD, and SSO tokens; average completion time observed = 2.1 hours (90th percentile < 4 hours).
- Exceptions: emergency/suspension flow includes temporary account freeze and escalation to security ops. Documentation: offboarding_workflow.drawio (attached).

If you need signed policy extracts (HR/People policy), I can pull them and redact PII before sharing. Also linking the Drive folder with exports: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcDeFg_Onboard-Evidence

-Neha Kapoor
Security & Compliance Program Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Laura Chen <lchen@acme.com>
To: neha.kapoor@redwood.ai, vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 13 May 2026 09:02:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Info request — onboarding/offboarding evidence for SOC2 review

Thanks Neha and Vivek — this is helpful and much of what we need. Couple follow-ups before our SOC2 reviewer call tomorrow:
- Can you confirm the retention period for background check raw reports vs. verification results? (we need the latter for audit evidence)
- For the 8% of global hires without Sterling checks, do you have compensating controls documented?

If you can drop short bullet answers into the Drive folder or reply briefly here, that'll be perfect. We'll review and confirm on the 5/14 call.

Best,
Laura

From: neha.kapoor@redwood.ai
To: Laura Chen <lchen@acme.com>, vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 13 May 2026 09:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Info request — onboarding/offboarding evidence for SOC2 review

Laura — quick bullets added here:
- Retention: raw background check reports are retained for 6 months by default (vendor policy); we retain verification outcome/metadata for 5 years in our encrypted HR store (export attached).
- Compensating controls for locations where Sterling can't operate: manual identity verification + manager attestation + local employment verification; documented in the People Ops exception register (Drive link).

I've uploaded a 1-page redacted export with timestamps and a CSV summary to the Drive folder. If you need any signatures on the vendor contract excerpt, flag which clauses and we'll produce a redacted PDF via legal.

-Neha
Security & Compliance Program Manager
Redwood Inference
